description: NGFS Phase V REMIND-MAgPIE 3.3-4.8 run with integrated chronic physical damages (median of the Kotz et al. 2024 damage distribution) fed back into the optimisation; counterpart of the no-damage run in IDs 967-973. Kotz et al. 2024 was retracted (NGFS statement, Dec 2025). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification. main_run set to FALSE by the orchestrator (25 Nov 2026): the IPD-median runs feed the Kotz et al. (2024) damage function back into REMIND, and NGFS reports that paper as retracted from Nature; kept in the dataset, excluded from the ESABCC 2040 main-run selection pending a Secretariat decision.
